investigations.claim: For every permutation pi, k_pi(j)=9-pos_pi(j) selects the desired axiom row; the replacement leaf block has25 commands and54 encoded fields. Generic stack/list reasoning gives a primitive-recursive derivation-witness translation, preserving high-level completeness.
investigations.source_inspection: The script enumerates all8! orders and8 selectors each, models the bottom-to-top symbolic stack, checks selected row/cache/old-stack endpoint and fixed length arithmetic. The note separately retains GEN, bundle, DISCARD, MP cleanup, the fourth Lukasiewicz parameter and theory bridge.
limits: The generic derivation induction is an ordinary stated argument; the script checks a finite symbolic stack model.
No binary compiler/runtime theorem or arbitrary-candidate-number bijection is proved.
Correct row builders must still preserve scalar parameters/scratches and move the unique u read correctly.

investigations.name: Finite-field affine register/header/gap resources
investigations.claim: For p=2,3,5,7,12 finite affine closures have6456 nonempty abstract sites and the same six exclusions. With absolute header H and spare count K, the exact fiber over register space A_i is H+sum(r)-K=15 mod p; with relative distance d and K it is A_i×F_p².
investigations.source_inspection: source_graph independently parses the pinned6459-node original Prog254, checks all8391 transitions and natural-category invariant. Domain implements canonical homogeneous affine spaces, affine intersection, hull and translation. Positive decrement is not incorrectly restricted to nonzero residues. Header and gap updates distinguish all three pointer-overflow cases. Fiber checking compares projections, dimensions and the conservation equation.
investigations.root_scope: Natural-category closure covers arbitrary N,A,D,X,Y,L with T=W=H=0. The affine worklist starts at the actual numeric seed(3,0,0,0,3,0,0,0,0), absolute header176 or relative distance181, and167 spare blocks.
limits: Without --recompute, only root containment, closure, exclusions and fibers are checked. Leastness requires the optional worklist regeneration equality.
Leastness is only in the stated reduced affine abstract interpretation. It does not show every abstract point is concretely reachable.
The result is for the original control graph and Prefix246 resource interpretation; no new245-path invariant is asserted.
No new exclusions are obtained and no obstruction to nonlinear invariants or alternative representations follows.

investigations.name: Finite propositional obstructions to restricting the fourth Lukasiewicz parameter
investigations.claim: One three-valued implication matrix validates L(u=F), ex falso and DNE but refutes K at(1,1). A second validates identity,K,ex falso,DNE and all three identified-parameter variants L(u=a/b/c), but refutes S at(1,1,0). Both preserve modus ponens at their designated value2.
investigations.source_inspection: The checker exhausts all valuations of each listed finite-arity axiom and all9 modus-ponens pairs per matrix, then checks the explicit bad valuation. It does not interpret quantifiers, membership, CP or GIC.
limits: This is incompleteness of exactly the listed propositional axiom bases.
It is not a countermodel of the full modified CP/GIC theory and proves no failure of equiconsistency with ZFC.
